mapper.select: select permission_id, p.module_id, p.sub_module_id, permission_desc, m.module_name, sm.sub_module_name, case when ${p_roleName} = 'M' then 'TRUE' else 'FALSE' end flag_sugg from permission p JOIN module m ON (p.module_id = m.module_id) LEFT OUTER JOIN sub_module sm ON (p.sub_module_id = sm.sub_module_id) where ${p_roleName} is not null order by m.MODULE_NAME, sm.SUB_MODULE_NAME, p.PERMISSION_DESC asc
select ROLE_DESCRIPTION from coded_role where ROLE_CODE = #{roleCode}

SELECT p.PERMISSION_ID, p.MODULE_ID, p.SUB_MODULE_ID, m.MODULE_NAME, sm.SUB_MODULE_NAME, p.PERMISSION_DESC, case when um.permission_id is not null then 'TRUE' else 'FALSE' end FLAG_SUGG
FROM permission p JOIN module m ON (p.module_id = m.module_id) LEFT OUTER JOIN sub_module sm ON (p.sub_module_id = sm.sub_module_id) LEFT OUTER JOIN user_permission_mapping um ON (p.permission_id = um.permission_id and EFFECTIVE_END_DATE is null and worker_region_id = #{p_worker_region_id}) where ${p_roleName} is not null UNION SELECT p.PERMISSION_ID, p.MODULE_ID, p.SUB_MODULE_ID, m.MODULE_NAME, sm.SUB_MODULE_NAME, p.PERMISSION_DESC, case when um.permission_id is not null then 'TRUE' else 'FALSE' end FLAG_SUGG FROM permission p JOIN module m ON (p.module_id = m.module_id) LEFT OUTER JOIN sub_module sm ON (p.sub_module_id = sm.sub_module_id) JOIN user_permission_mapping um ON (p.permission_id = um.permission_id and um.EFFECTIVE_END_DATE is null and um.worker_region_id = #{p_worker_region_id} and ${p_roleName} is null) order by MODULE_NAME, SUB_MODULE_NAME, PERMISSION_DESC asc

select EMAIL_ADDR from NYEHMS_USERS where (end_Date is null or end_Date > SYSDATE) and EMAIL_ADDR is not null
select LEGACY_UID from NYEHMS_USERS where (end_Date is null or end_Date > SYSDATE) and IS_LOCKED = 'N'
